intake.instructions: Does the recorded intake state a bounded scope, explicit success criteria, and file/role limits?

criteria.true: Intake names the unit, its scope of work, measurable success criteria, and which roles/files are in play.
criteria.false: Intake is vague, missing success criteria, or has no documented bounds.

intake.instructions: Is a responsible owner model assigned to every stage, with director sign-off separate?

criteria.true: Each stage has an explicit owning role and model; the sign-off stage is not owned by any worker role.
criteria.false: Ownership is missing or the sign-off authority is assigned to a worker.

research.instructions: Did research either identify an established reference implementation or explicitly document a search/rationale for none?

criteria.true: A reference comparison pathway is named with limits, or a documented search and rationale explains why none exists.
criteria.false: Reference handling is silent or omitted.

spec.instructions: Is the five-part scientific package complete: verification test, validation plan, uncertainty model, domain of validity, reference pathway?

criteria.true: All five required parts are present, versioned, and bound to the proposal.
criteria.false: One or more of the five parts is missing or unbound.

spec.instructions: Are changes to existing physics or constants routed through change-requests with old/new values and rationale?

criteria.true: Assumption/constant changes identify affected IDs, old and new behavior, evidence, and Director disposition.
criteria.false: A change is asserted without a recorded change request.

engineering_spec.instructions: Does the engineering spec bound the tooling scope, the frozen physics contract, and the artifacts it will produce?

criteria.true: The spec names the CLI, the accepted engine it exercises, explicit frozen-physics limits, and the deliverable artifact paths.
criteria.false: Scope, frozen-physics contract, or deliverables are open-ended or unstated.

engineering_spec.instructions: Does the engineering spec leave all physics assumptions, equations, constants, and tolerances unchanged, routing any apparent need for change to a change-request?

criteria.true: Spec declares no physics change and funnels any needed change to a documented change-request.
criteria.false: Spec proposes or implies a silent physics or constant change.

engineering_spec.instructions: Does the engineering spec name a concrete reference path (accepted implementation, fixture, or numerical budget) to compare against?

criteria.true: A named reference implementation or numerical budget is bound to the verification.

design-review.instructions: Are numeric acceptance criteria and tolerances agreed between physics and software?

criteria.true: Acceptance criteria are numeric and measurable with stated tolerances.
criteria.false: Acceptance is described in qualitative terms.

implement.instructions: Did implementation touch only approved files, and decline out-of-scope work?

criteria.true: Changed paths stay within the role's permitted scope and the approved spec area.
criteria.false: Implementation wrote outside its lane or changed unapproved science/constants.

implement.instructions: Did implementation report executed tests, commands, and output evidence in the handoff?

criteria.true: Handoff lists concrete commands, outputs, pass/fail outcomes and changed paths.
criteria.false: Handoff asserts completion without runnable evidence.

self-review.instructions: Did a reviewer other than the implementer check the diff against the approved spec hash?

criteria.true: A distinct reviewer compared the diff to the spec and stated any drift or rejection.
criteria.false: Review was skipped or performed by the implementer.

validate.instructions: Did independent validation actively try to falsify with sweeps, dimension checks, edge cases, or convergence?

criteria.true: Report describes concrete falsification attempts and their outcomes, not just successful reproduction.
criteria.false: Validation is a reproduction run with no adversarial checks.

validate.instructions: Was validation executed by a separate model instance distinct from software implementation?

criteria.true: Validation model id differs from the implementation model id and the roles are distinct.
criteria.false: Same model or same role performed both implementation and validation.

validate.instructions: Are evidence artifacts hash-bound and the report linked to a source fingerprint?

criteria.true: Evidence has a sha256 and the report records the source fingerprint at execution time.
criteria.false: Evidence or fingerprint binding is missing.

gate.instructions: Is every prior stage done, audited by Jev, evidence-bound, and free of resolved blockers?

criteria.true: All prior stages done, Jev audits recorded above block threshold, evidence hashes match.
criteria.false: A stage is incomplete, unaudited, or evidence is stale or missing.

accept.instructions: Is the Director (big-pickle) the only sign-off authority, with no worker agent authorized to approve?

criteria.true: Acceptance is recorded by the director role only, on top of a passing gate.
criteria.false: A worker or payload claims the right to accept a milestone.
